stem: What was the purpose of this World War II poster?
instruction: Study the poster and answer the question that follows.

options.label: F
options.text: To persuade women to purchase food ration coupons

options.label: G
options.text: To encourage families to put more money into bank savings accounts

options.label: H
options.text: To encourage citizens to help pay for the costs of the war

options.label: J
